summary_en: This phase 2 single-arm study tests autologous M-CENK adoptive cell therapy and N-803 (an IL-15 superagonist) together with gemcitabine in people with recurrent platinum-resistant high-grade ovarian cancer. M-CENK is given by IV infusion on Day 1 of each 4-week cycle for as long as cells are available, N-803 is given under the skin at a fixed 1.2 mg dose on Days 1 and 15 starting in Cycle 2, and gemcitabine 800 mg/m2 is given IV on Days 1, 8, and 15 of each cycle. The study measures safety and preliminary efficacy.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2, de un solo grupo, evalúa la terapia celular adoptiva autóloga M-CENK y N-803 (un superagonista de IL-15) junto con gemcitabina en personas con cáncer de ovario recurrente de alto grado resistente al platino. M-CENK se administra por infusión IV el Día 1 de cada ciclo de 4 semanas mientras haya células disponibles, N-803 se administra por vía subcutánea a una dosis fija de 1.2 mg los Días 1 y 15 a partir del Ciclo 2, y la gemcitabina de 800 mg/m2 se administra por vía IV los Días 1, 8 y 15 de cada ciclo. El estudio mide la seguridad y la eficacia preliminar.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older and younger than 85 years.
Platinum-resistant high-grade epithelial ovarian, primary peritoneal, or fallopian tube cancer, relapsed within 6 months of 1 to 3 platinum regimens.
At least one measurable lesion by RECIST v1.1.
Prior treatment with bevacizumab, and prior FRα testing with mirvetuximab offered if positive.
ECOG performance status of 1 or less.
not_for: Clear cell, mucinous, sarcomatous, low grade, or borderline ovarian tumors.
Distant spread outside the abdominal and pelvic cavity, such as to brain, lung, or bone.
Presence or history of ascites or bowel obstruction.
HIV, active uncontrolled hepatitis B or C, or interstitial lung disease or non-infectious pneumonitis.
Autoimmune disease such as inflammatory bowel disease, rheumatoid arthritis, or lupus.
